stories.title: Natural Cycles’ new wristband adds daytime activity tracking and a battery life boost.
stories.summary:
The original NC Band launched earlier this year as an alternative to wearing an Apple Watch or Oura Ring overnight to collect temperature and activity data for the company’s controversial FDA-cleared birth control app. The new NC Band 2 boosts battery life to 21 days with a lighter and thinner design. It’s available for preorder today and comes free with a $149-per-year Natural Cycles subscription, while existing subscribers can get one for $99.

stories.title: Gemini Gems are retiring today.
stories.summary:
As announced in September, from today Gems are now read-only, meaning you can’t use or edit them, and will disappear entirely from personal accounts on December 17th. Your Gems should automatically become Skills, Google’s replacement, but you can manually recreate them if need be. Skills have been updated with file attachments and sharing options to help the transition.
[Link: Google adds file attachments and sharing to Gemini Skills as Gems retire starting today | https://www.androidauthority.com/google-gemini-skills-file-attachments-sharing-gems-retire-3735963/ | Android Authority]
